verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ אַֽחֲרֵי־ כֵ֔ן וַיָּ֕מָת מֶ֖לֶךְ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ חָנ֥וּן בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên way·yā·māṯ me·leḵ bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn way·yim·lōḵ ḥā·nūn bə·nōw taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: Some time later . . . the king of the Ammonites . . . died and was succeeded by his son Hanun

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜ד אֶעֱשֶׂה־ חֶ֣סֶד׀ עִם־ חָנ֣וּן בֶּן־ נָחָ֗שׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ עָשָׂ֨ה אָבִ֤יו עִמָּדִי֙ חֶ֔סֶד וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח דָּוִ֧ד לְנַחֲמ֛וֹ בְּיַד־ עֲבָדָ֖יו אֶל־ אָבִ֑יו וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ עַבְדֵ֣י דָוִ֔ד אֶ֖רֶץ בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer dā·wiḏ ’e·‘ĕ·śeh- ḥe·seḏ ‘im- ḥā·nūn ben- nā·ḥāš ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh ’ā·ḇîw ‘im·mā·ḏî ḥe·seḏ way·yiš·laḥ dā·wiḏ lə·na·ḥă·mōw bə·yaḏ- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw ’el- ’ā·ḇîw way·yā·ḇō·’ū ‘aḇ·ḏê ḏā·wiḏ ’e·reṣ bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn
verses.literal: And David said I will show kindness to Hanun son of Nahash just as his father showed kindness to me So David sent some of his servants to console Hanun . . . concerning his father But when they . . . arrived in the land of the Ammonites . . .

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְרוּ֩ שָׂרֵ֨י בְנֵֽי־ עַמּ֜וֹן אֶל־ חָנ֣וּן אֲדֹֽנֵיהֶ֗ם הַֽמְכַבֵּ֨ד דָּוִ֤ד אֶת־ אָבִ֙יךָ֙ בְּעֵינֶ֔יךָ כִּֽי־ שָׁלַ֥ח לְךָ֖ מְנַֽחֲמִ֑ים הֲ֠לוֹא בַּעֲב֞וּר חֲק֤וֹר אֶת־ הָעִיר֙ וּלְרַגְּלָ֣הּ וּלְהָפְכָ֔הּ שָׁלַ֥ח דָּוִ֛ד אֶת־ עֲבָדָ֖יו אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū śā·rê ḇə·nê- ‘am·mō·wn ’el- ḥā·nūn ’ă·ḏō·nê·hem ham·ḵab·bêḏ dā·wiḏ ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇî·ḵā bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā kî- šā·laḥ lə·ḵā mə·na·ḥă·mîm hă·lō·w ba·‘ă·ḇūr ḥă·qō·wr ’eṯ- hā·‘îr ū·lə·rag·gə·lāh ū·lə·hā·p̄ə·ḵāh šā·laḥ dā·wiḏ ’eṯ- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw ’ê·le·ḵā
verses.literal: the princes of the Ammonites . . . said to Hanun their lord Just because David has sent you comforters do you really believe he is showing respect for your father Has not David instead sent his servants . . . to explore the city spy it out and overthrow it

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח חָנ֜וּן אֶת־ עַבְדֵ֣י דָוִ֗ד וַיְגַלַּח֙ אֶת־ חֲצִ֣י זְקָנָ֔ם וַיִּכְרֹ֧ת אֶת־ מַדְוֵיהֶ֛ם בַּחֵ֖צִי עַ֣ד שְׁתֽוֹתֵיהֶ֑ם וַֽיְשַׁלְּחֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ḥā·nūn ’eṯ- ‘aḇ·ḏê ḏā·wiḏ way·ḡal·laḥ ’eṯ- ḥă·ṣî zə·qā·nām way·yiḵ·rōṯ ’eṯ- maḏ·wê·hem ba·ḥê·ṣî ‘aḏ šə·ṯō·w·ṯê·hem way·šal·lə·ḥêm
verses.literal: So Hanun took David’s servants shaved off half of each man’s beard cut off their garments at the hips and sent them away

verses.original: וַיַּגִּ֤דוּ לְדָוִד֙ וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח לִקְרָאתָ֔ם כִּֽי־ הָי֥וּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים נִכְלָמִ֣ים מְאֹ֑ד וַיֹּ֤אמֶר הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ שְׁב֣וּ בִֽירֵח֔וֹ עַד־ יְצַמַּ֥ח זְקַנְכֶ֖ם וְשַׁבְתֶּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yag·gi·ḏū lə·ḏā·wiḏ way·yiš·laḥ liq·rā·ṯām kî- hā·yū hā·’ă·nā·šîm niḵ·lā·mîm mə·’ōḏ way·yō·mer ham·me·leḵ šə·ḇū ḇî·rê·ḥōw ‘aḏ- yə·ṣam·maḥ zə·qan·ḵem wə·šaḇ·tem
verses.literal: When this was reported to David he sent messengers to meet the men since they had been . . . thoroughly humiliated The king told them Stay in Jericho until your beards have grown back and then return

verses.original: וַיִּרְאוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן כִּ֥י נִבְאֲשׁ֖וּ בְּדָוִ֑ד וַיִּשְׁלְח֣וּ בְנֵֽי־ עַמּ֡וֹן וַיִּשְׂכְּרוּ֩ אֶת־ אֲרַ֨ם בֵּית־ רְח֜וֹב וְאֶת־ אֲרַ֣ם צוֹבָ֗א עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֙לֶף֙ רַגְלִ֔י וְאֶת־ מֶ֤לֶךְ מַֽעֲכָה֙ אֶ֣לֶף אִ֔ישׁ וְאִ֣ישׁ ט֔וֹב שְׁנֵים־ עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֖לֶף אִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yir·’ū bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn kî niḇ·’ă·šū bə·ḏā·wiḏ way·yiš·lə·ḥū ḇə·nê- ‘am·mō·wn way·yiś·kə·rū ’eṯ- ’ă·ram bêṯ- rə·ḥō·wḇ wə·’eṯ- ’ă·ram ṣō·w·ḇā ‘eś·rîm ’e·lep̄ raḡ·lî wə·’eṯ- me·leḵ ma·‘ă·ḵāh ’e·lep̄ ’îš wə·’îš ṭō·wḇ šə·nêm- ‘ā·śār ’e·lep̄ ’îš
verses.literal: When the Ammonites . . . . . . realized that they had become a stench to David . . . they . . . hired twenty thousand Aramean foot soldiers from Beth-rehob and Zoba as well as a thousand men from the king of Maacah and twelve . . . . . . thousand men from Tob

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֖ע דָּוִ֑ד וַיִּשְׁלַח֙ אֶת־ יוֹאָ֔ב וְאֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַצָּבָ֖א הַגִּבֹּרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ dā·wiḏ way·yiš·laḥ ’eṯ- yō·w·’āḇ wə·’êṯ kāl- haṣ·ṣā·ḇā hag·gib·bō·rîm
verses.literal: On hearing this David sent Joab and the entire army of mighty men

verses.original: וַיֵּֽצְאוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וַיַּעַרְכ֥וּ מִלְחָמָ֖ה פֶּ֣תַח הַשָּׁ֑עַר וַאֲרַ֨ם צוֹבָ֤א וּרְחוֹב֙ וְאִֽישׁ־ ט֣וֹב וּמַֽעֲכָ֔ה לְבַדָּ֖ם בַּשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣə·’ū bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn way·ya·‘ar·ḵū mil·ḥā·māh pe·ṯaḥ haš·šā·‘ar wa·’ă·ram ṣō·w·ḇā ū·rə·ḥō·wḇ wə·’îš- ṭō·wḇ ū·ma·‘ă·ḵāh lə·ḇad·dām baś·śā·ḏeh
verses.literal: The Ammonites . . . marched out and arrayed themselves for battle at the entrance of the city gate while the Arameans of Zobah and Rehob and the men of Tob and Maacah were by themselves in the open country

verses.original: וַיַּ֣רְא יוֹאָ֗ב כִּֽי־ הָיְתָ֤ה אֵלָיו֙ פְּנֵ֣י הַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה מִפָּנִ֖ים וּמֵֽאָח֑וֹר וַיִּבְחַ֗ר מִכֹּל֙ בְּחוּרֵ֣י בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַֽיַּעֲרֹ֖ךְ לִקְרַ֥את אֲרָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar yō·w·’āḇ kî- hā·yə·ṯāh ’ê·lāw pə·nê ham·mil·ḥā·māh mip·pā·nîm ū·mê·’ā·ḥō·wr way·yiḇ·ḥar mik·kōl bə·ḥū·rê bə·yiś·rå̄·ʾēl way·ya·‘ă·rōḵ liq·raṯ ’ă·rām
verses.literal: When Joab saw the battle lines before him and behind him he selected some of the best men of Israel and arrayed them against the Arameans

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ יֶ֣תֶר הָעָ֔ם נָתַ֕ן בְּיַ֖ד אַבְשַׁ֣י אָחִ֑יו וַֽיַּעֲרֹ֕ךְ לִקְרַ֖את בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ ye·ṯer hā·‘ām nā·ṯan bə·yaḏ ’aḇ·šay ’ā·ḥîw way·ya·‘ă·rōḵ liq·raṯ bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn
verses.literal: And he placed the rest of the troops under the command of his brother Abishai who arrayed them against the Ammonites . . .

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אִם־ תֶּחֱזַ֤ק אֲרָם֙ מִמֶּ֔נִּי וְהָיִ֥תָה לִּ֖י לִֽישׁוּעָ֑ה וְאִם־ בְּנֵ֤י עַמּוֹן֙ יֶחֱזְק֣וּ מִמְּךָ֔ וְהָלַכְתִּ֖י לְהוֹשִׁ֥יעַֽ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’im- te·ḥĕ·zaq ’ă·rām mim·men·nî wə·hā·yi·ṯāh lî lî·šū·‘āh wə·’im- bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn ye·ḥĕz·qū mim·mə·ḵā wə·hā·laḵ·tî lə·hō·wō·šî·a‘ lāḵ
verses.literal: If the Arameans are too strong for me said Joab then you will come to my rescue . . . And if the Ammonites . . . are too strong for you then I will come to your rescue . . .

verses.original: חֲזַ֤ק וְנִתְחַזַּק֙ בְּעַד־ עַמֵּ֔נוּ וּבְעַ֖ד עָרֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וַֽיהוָ֔ה יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה הַטּ֖וֹב בְּעֵינָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·zaq wə·niṯ·ḥaz·zaq bə·‘aḏ- ‘am·mê·nū ū·ḇə·‘aḏ ‘ā·rê ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū Yah·weh ya·‘ă·śeh haṭ·ṭō·wḇ bə·‘ê·nāw
verses.literal: Be strong and let us fight bravely for our people and for the cities of our God May the LORD do what is good in His sight

verses.original: וַיִּגַּ֣שׁ יוֹאָ֗ב וְהָעָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עִמּ֔וֹ לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה בַּֽאֲרָ֑ם וַיָּנֻ֖סוּ מִפָּנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yig·gaš yō·w·’āḇ wə·hā·‘ām ’ă·šer ‘im·mōw lam·mil·ḥā·māh ba·’ă·rām way·yā·nu·sū mip·pā·nāw
verses.literal: So Joab and his troops - advanced to fight the Arameans who fled before him

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֨י עַמּ֤וֹן רָאוּ֙ כִּי־ נָ֣ס אֲרָ֔ם וַיָּנֻ֙סוּ֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י אֲבִישַׁ֔י וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ הָעִ֑יר וַיָּ֣שָׁב יוֹאָ֗ב מֵעַל֙ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וַיָּבֹ֖א יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê ‘am·mō·wn rā·’ū kî- nās ’ă·rām way·yā·nu·sū mip·pə·nê ’ă·ḇî·šay way·yā·ḇō·’ū hā·‘îr way·yā·šāḇ yō·w·’āḇ mê·‘al bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn way·yā·ḇō yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: When the Ammonites . . . saw that the Arameans had fled they too fled before Abishai and they entered the city So Joab returned from fighting against the Ammonites . . . and came to Jerusalem

verses.original: וַיַּ֣רְא אֲרָ֔ם כִּ֥י נִגַּ֖ף לִפְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֵּאָסְפ֖וּ יָֽחַד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar ’ă·rām kî nig·gap̄ lip̄·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yê·’ā·sə·p̄ū yā·ḥaḏ
verses.literal: When the Arameans saw that they had been defeated by Israel they regrouped . . .

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח הֲדַדְעֶ֗זֶר וַיֹּצֵ֤א אֶת־ אֲרָם֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ מֵעֵ֣בֶר הַנָּהָ֔ר וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ חֵילָ֑ם וְשׁוֹבַ֛ךְ שַׂר־ צְבָ֥א הֲדַדְעֶ֖זֶר לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ hă·ḏaḏ·‘e·zer way·yō·ṣê ’eṯ- ’ă·rām ’ă·šer mê·‘ê·ḇer han·nā·hār way·yā·ḇō·’ū ḥê·lām wə·šō·w·ḇaḵ śar- ṣə·ḇā hă·ḏaḏ·‘e·zer lip̄·nê·hem
verses.literal: Hadadezer sent messengers to bring more Arameans from beyond the Euphrates and they came to Helam with Shobach the commander of Hadadezer’s army leading them

verses.original: וַיֻּגַּ֣ד לְדָוִ֗דס וַיֶּאֱסֹ֤ף אֶת־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַיַּעֲבֹ֣ר אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן וַיָּבֹ֖א חֵלָ֑אמָה וַיַּעַרְכ֤וּ אֲרָם֙ לִקְרַ֣את דָּוִ֔ד וַיִּלָּחֲמ֖וּ עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yug·gaḏ lə·ḏå̄·wi·ḏs way·ye·’ĕ·sōp̄ ’eṯ- kāl- yiś·rā·’êl way·ya·‘ă·ḇōr ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên way·yā·ḇō ḥê·lā·māh way·ya·‘ar·ḵū ’ă·rām liq·raṯ dā·wiḏ way·yil·lā·ḥă·mū ‘im·mōw
verses.literal: When this was reported to David he gathered all Israel crossed the Jordan and went to Helam Then the Arameans arrayed themselves against David and fought against him

verses.original: וַיָּ֣נָס אֲרָם֮ מִפְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַיַּהֲרֹ֨ג דָּוִ֜ד מֵאֲרָ֗ם שְׁבַ֤ע מֵאוֹת֙ רֶ֔כֶב וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף פָּרָשִׁ֑ים וְאֵ֨ת שׁוֹבַ֧ךְ שַׂר־ צְבָא֛וֹ הִכָּ֖ה וַיָּ֥מָת שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·nās ’ă·rām mip·pə·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·ya·hă·rōḡ dā·wiḏ mê·’ă·rām šə·ḇa‘ mê·’ō·wṯ re·ḵeḇ wə·’ar·bā·‘îm ’e·lep̄ pā·rā·šîm wə·’êṯ šō·w·ḇaḵ śar- ṣə·ḇā·’ōw hik·kāh way·yā·māṯ šām
verses.literal: But the Arameans fled before Israel and David . . . killed seven hundred charioteers and forty thousand foot soldiers He also struck down Shobach the commander of their army who died there

verses.original: וַיִּרְא֨וּ כָֽל־ הַמְּלָכִ֜ים עַבְדֵ֣י הֲדַדְעֶ֗זֶר כִּ֤י נִגְּפוּ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיַּשְׁלִ֥מוּ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַיַּֽעַבְד֑וּם וַיִּֽרְא֣וּ אֲרָ֔ם לְהוֹשִׁ֥יעַ ע֖וֹד אֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yir·’ū ḵāl ham·mə·lā·ḵîm ‘aḇ·ḏê hă·ḏaḏ·‘e·zer kî nig·gə·p̄ū lip̄·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yaš·li·mū ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl way·ya·‘aḇ·ḏūm way·yir·’ū ’ă·rām lə·hō·wō·šî·a‘ ‘ō·wḏ ’eṯ- bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn
verses.literal: When all the kings who were subject to Hadadezer saw that they had been defeated by Israel they made peace with Israel and became subject to them So the Arameans were afraid to help the Ammonites . . . anymore
